place_fields.summary: A bear rescue and rehabilitation facility associated with Bannerghatta Biological Park and Wildlife SOS, caring for rescued dancing sloth bears.

planning_attributes.description: The Bannerghatta Bear Rescue and Rehabilitation Centre cares for rescued dancing sloth bears and operates as an off-display rescue centre within the Bannerghatta Biological Park area.
planning_attributes.legend_or_history: Wildlife SOS and the Zoo Authority of Karnataka signed a memorandum of understanding in November 2005 to establish the Bannerghatta Bear Rescue and Rehabilitation Centre.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: Reach Bannerghatta Biological Park in Bannerghatta, Bengaluru; the bear rescue centre is within the park's bear-safari area.
planning_attributes.access_restrictions: The bear rescue centre is off-display and is not open to the public.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: Because the centre is off-display, visitors should not attempt to enter or approach the rescue facility.
local_name_variants: Bannerghatta Bear Rescue and Rehabilitation Centre
planning_attributes.notes: The facility was allocated an area of about 8 acres within the existing bear safari for rescued sloth bears.

place_fields.summary: A pet and animal park near Nandi Hills offering guided, interactive experiences with animals and birds.

planning_attributes.description: Jeeva Park offers a 90-minute guided interactive tour with opportunities to feed, touch and learn about animals and birds.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: Jeeva Park is near Nandi Hills at Mayasandra, Koira, Devanahalli Taluk, Karnataka 562164.
planning_attributes.access_restrictions: The official site states that tour slots can be pre-booked online; no other general access restriction was identified.
planning_attributes.notes: The official site describes a 90-minute farm visit with more than 60 species and 500 animals; it lists opening hours as 8:30 AM to 5:30 PM and says it is open all days.

place_fields.summary: A butterfly conservation and education facility within Bannerghatta Biological Park with a butterfly garden, conservatory, museum and research and breeding facilities.

planning_attributes.description: Bannerghatta's Butterfly Park is an integrated conservation, education and research centre focused on butterflies, with a garden, conservatory, insectarium, museum, audio-visual centre and breeding laboratory.
planning_attributes.legend_or_history: The park was identified as a priority butterfly habitat in 2001 and gave rise to India's first Butterfly Park at Bannerghatta in association with the Government of India and Government of Karnataka.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: Reach Bannerghatta Biological Park in Bannerghatta, Bengaluru; the Butterfly Park is accessed from the zoo campus via a short walk.
planning_attributes.access_restrictions: Bannerghatta Biological Park, including the Butterfly Park, is closed every Tuesday for weekly maintenance.
planning_attributes.notes: Karnataka Tourism lists the Butterfly Park as open from 9:30 AM to 5:00 PM; an independent visitor listing gives a 20–30 minute duration, represented here as 30 minutes.
